verdict.rationale: LocalAI is a self-hosted, OpenAI-compatible server on localhost, runnable via Docker. You can point existing OpenAI or Anthropic clients at it as an isolated local test target instead of a production endpoint, and its shell agent asks for approval before any state-changing command. However, nothing in the docs presents this as a sandbox or test mode that separates test traffic from production data. missing for 10: an explicitly documented sandbox/test environment or mode, isolation guarantees for agent command execution beyond the approval gate, test-data or production-separation guidance, independent hands-on corroboration.
